deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's current admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into a Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Go to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Policies"
2. Click on the "Returns" tab and select the return policy you want to edit
3. Scroll down to the "Return Form" section and click on the "Edit" button next to it
4. In the "Return Form" editor, click on the "Add a new field" button
5. Select "Text Field" as the field type and enter a label for your returns reason capture form (e.g., "Reason for Return")
6. Click on the "Save" button to save the changes to your return policy
7. To display the returns reason capture form in your Shopify store, you'll need to add it to your theme's liquid template files.

9. Save your changes to the `returns.liquid` file and preview your store in a new browser tab
10. Test the returns reason capture form by initiating a return from your Shopify store and filling out the form
If you encounter any issues or need further assistance, please consult Shopify's documentation or contact their support team.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Loop Returns
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges. When a customer initiates a return, Loop suggests alternative products, different sizes, or store credit. Directly reduces refund leakage for fashion brands with high size-related return rates. Provides structured returns data as a byproduct.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Not a single tool but a strategy: running primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list ensures no single marketing automation vendor holds all customer communication. Both export subscriber lists in standard CSV — satisfying Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 portability requirements.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts

recommended_ai_agents.name: Iubenda (AI processing disclosure)
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Iubenda's AI processing disclosure templates specifically cover the UK AI Bill 2026 transparency requirements — informing customers when AI is used in decisions affecting them. For fashion SMEs deploying sizing or recommendation AI, this is the lowest-cost path to meeting transparency obligations.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Prediko
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: AI-powered inventory forecasting for Shopify brands. Provides accurate stock predictions, automated purchase order recommendations, real-time restock alerts, and inventory reports. Reduces overstock and stockout through data-driven buying decisions.
